label: coach_gym_nomal_first_00
text: Hello. I’m here on behalf of the Paldea region’s\nPokémon League.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: coach_gym_nomal_first_01
text: It’s a pleasure to be doing business with you.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: coach_gym_nomal_sp01_01
text: Calling me all the way out to another region...\nIs a certain chairwoman rubbing off on you?[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: coach_gym_nomal_sp01_02
text: Actually, don’t worry about it. To be honest,\nI don’t mind these little business trips.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: coach_gym_nomal_sp01_03
text: I know I’m here for work, but I may as well enjoy\nmyself while I’m at it.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: coach_gym_nomal_sp01_04
text: Speaking of which, I’ve heard that Unova has two\nparticularly famous dishes—Berry sandwiches and\r\nCasteliacones. Which one appeals to you more?[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: coach_gym_nomal_sp01_select_01
text: Berry sandwiches

label: coach_gym_nomal_sp01_select_02
text: Casteliacones

label: coach_gym_nomal_sp01_05
text: Ah, I see. It figures you would be more interested\nin the sandwiches.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: coach_gym_nomal_sp01_05b
text: Ah, I see. I suppose you must have a sweet tooth.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: coach_gym_nomal_sp01_06
text: Well, thanks for the input...[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: coach_gym_nomal_sp01_07
text: Once I’m done with my lecture, I’ll step out and\neat my fill.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: coach_gym_nomal_sp02_00
text: Oh. You again.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: coach_gym_nomal_sp02_01
text:
I tried out those Berry sandwiches we discussed.\c
They were pretty good, actually—a nice change
of pace from the usual Paldean sandwiches.\c
Staraptor kept pecking at mine, though... I guess
the Berries used in the sandwich filling must’ve
been to its liking.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: coach_gym_nomal_sp02_01b
text:
I tried out those Casteliacones we discussed.
They were far more satisfying than I’d expected.\c
The texture was nice and fluffy, but the flavor was
so rich—almost decadent.\c
The Nacli Salt Ice Cream from Sugar-N-Ice back
in Paldea is hard to beat, but Casteliacones
definitely come close, since they contain only
the finest ingredients...[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: coach_gym_nomal_sp02_02
text: I’m sorry. I didn’t mean to go on like that.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: coach_gym_nomal_sp02_03
text: It’s just that the best part of traveling is trying out\nall the local dishes, if you ask me.\c\nThe topic tends to make me talkative.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: coach_gym_nomal_sp02_04
text: There’s something special about having nice,\nfamiliar rice balls once you’re back home, too...[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: coach_gym_nomal_sp03_00
text: By the way...\c\nHave you had a chance to visit the cafeteria here\nat Blueberry Academy?[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: coach_gym_nomal_sp03_01
text: It’s pretty nice, isn’t it?[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: coach_gym_nomal_sp03_01b
text: Is that so...? Well, it’s pretty nice.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: coach_gym_nomal_sp03_02
text: They season the food with a heavy hand—which\nthe students here prefer, I suppose. But the sheer\r\nquantity is what’s truly noteworthy.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: coach_gym_nomal_sp03_03
text: The mountain of fries you get when you order the\nAcademy Fries nearly made me dance.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: coach_gym_nomal_sp03_04
text: If you haven’t tried it for yourself, I would\ndefinitely recommend it.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: coach_gym_nomal_trade_01_00
text: You know, I didn’t expect you to pay so much\nattention to my ramblings.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: coach_gym_nomal_trade_01_01
text: You really are a strange one, aren’t you.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: coach_gym_nomal_trade_01_02
text: Well, that suits me just fine. Maybe you’d even\nbe interested in trading Pokémon with me?[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: coach_gym_nomal_trade_01_03
text: I’ll be putting up a Dudunsparce, but you can\ntrade whatever Pokémon you feel like.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: coach_gym_nomal_trade_01_04
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x1303(0001,0000)][VAR 0x0101(0001)]... Interesting. This will be
fun
to
raise.
Thank you for the trade.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: coach_gym_nomal_trade_02_00
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Do you want to trade your [VAR 0x0101(0001)] for\nmy\r\nDudunsparce?[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: coach_gym_nomal_trade_02_01
text: You can’t trade Larry a Pokémon if you aren’t its\noriginal Trainer!

label: coach_gym_nomal_trade_02_02
text: You can’t trade Larry such a rare Pokémon!

label: coach_gym_nomal_trade_02_03
text: You can’t trade Larry a Shiny Pokémon!

label: coach_gym_nomal_trade_03_00
text:
Ah, but no. I don’t think trading is a good idea if
you’ve only got one Pokémon in your party...\c
Better to cut risks and trade when you have at
least two.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: coach_gym_nomal_trade_03_01
text: All right, then... Maybe another time when our\nschedules align.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: coach_gym_nomal_trade_04_00
text: Are you interested in resuming our trade talk?[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: coach_gym_nomal_talkto_00
text: You have a certain look—a look that says you\nwant to battle me.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: coach_gym_nomal_cancel_00
text: Ah. My mistake, I suppose. Apologies.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: coach_gym_nomal_battlestart_00
text: I’m technically off the clock now, but...fine.\nLet’s have a battle.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: coach_teacher_dragon_battlestart_01
text: [EMPTY 55]

label: coach_gym_nomal_battleend_win_00_00
text: Impressive skills...[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: coach_gym_nomal_battleend_win_00_01
text: You just keep getting stronger, don’t you?[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: coach_gym_nomal_battleend_win_00_02
text: I imagine you worked up a sweat. Here, take\nthese.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: coach_gym_nomal_battleend_win_00_03
text: It’s important to replenish your minerals.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: coach_gym_nomal_reward_00
text: [EMPTY 55]

label: coach_gym_nomal_battleend_win_01_00
text: Here, I’ll give you a reward, so...think we can call\nit a day?[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: coach_gym_nomal_battleend_win_01_01
text: Now then, if you’ll excuse me...[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: coach_gym_nomal_battleend_lose_00_00
text: Even you stumble sometimes, I see. Well, for\nwhat it’s worth...a lot can happen in life.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: coach_gym_nomal_randomtalk_00
text:
I admit, I think I did a good job coming up with
Medali’s Gym Test.\c
Having the challengers battle each other is a
great way to whittle down their numbers.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: coach_gym_nomal_randomtalk_01
text:
I hope La Primera isn’t giving you too much
trouble.\c
Take it from me—you need to say no to her if you
don’t want to do something. Otherwise you’ll run
yourself into the ground.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: coach_gym_nomal_randomtalk_02
text: I think the real problem with the Elite Trial is that\nHassel is the one after me. Rika or Poppy would\r\nhear me just fine, even if I didn’t shout.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: coach_gym_nomal_randomtalk_03
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0101(0001)] appears to be doing
well—and
I
don’t
think
it’s
using
Facade.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: coach_gym_nomal_randomtalk_04
text:
How’s the Dudunsparce I traded you?\c
His Tera Type is Flying, so I suppose you could
call him a “Dudunspairce”...\c
... ... ...\c
...Ahem.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: coach_gym_nomal_randomtalk_sp
text:
The boss contacted me the other day...\c
She said you’d given my name when asked about
your favorite Gym Leader.\c
I really don’t understand your choice. Why would
you pick an average Joe like me?\c
Maybe you’re overworked and it’s affecting your
judgment...? I know a good park where you could
go to unwind, if that’s the case.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]
